purpose: Post-fix rocprofv3 kernel-trace breakdown of split-K batch attention (context kernel vs gate reducer) to decide whether parallelizing the reducer's serial cross-split merge is worth pursuing.
method: scripts/probe_splitk_rocprof_breakdown.py --case {b8,b6}; 5 warmup + 50 timed calls; rocprofv3 --kernel-trace; per-call = family total / dispatch count
decision: Reducer is 7.2-7.3% of attention time; parallel merge ceiling ~3.6% of attention (~1-2% end-to-end at 128K). Skip. Context kernel (92.7%) is bandwidth-bound KV reads; its lever is KV storage size, a separate quality-gated workstream.
